body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to Singapore with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 2–4 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in Singapore

Singapore shops use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in Singapore

Singapore is hot and humid all year, with strong air-conditioning indoors: breathable cotton, kota doria and lined georgette, plus a light dupatta, are the most comfortable choices.

## Festivals and wedding season

Deepavali is a public holiday in Singapore, and Little India comes alive for the festival every year. Weddings and pujas take place all year round. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to Singapore take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 2–4 working days and custom-fit pieces in 5–7 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in Singapore?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to Singapore dollars.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost.
